episodes.name: From Script to Screen S02E01 "June"
episodes.overview: Sometimes you can say more with a look and silence than you can with words. See how The Handmaid's Tale goes from script to your screen in this scene from Season 2, Episode 1 -- "June."

episodes.name: Inside the Episode S02E01 "June"
episodes.overview: Elisabeth Moss (June), Yvonne Strahovski (Serena Joy), Warren Littlefield (Executive Producer) and Bruce Miller (Creator) dive into the Season 2 premiere of The Handmaid's Tale—from the opening at Fenway Park to the defiant closing moments of episode 1.

episodes.name: From Script to Screen S02E02 "Unwomen"
episodes.overview: Explore the sights and sounds of this new world. "Welcome" to the Colonies. See how The Handmaid's Tale goes from script to your screen in this scene from Season 2, Episode 2 -- "Unwomen."

episodes.name: Inside the Episode S02E02 "Unwomen"
episodes.overview: Elisabeth Moss (June), Alexis Bledel (Emily), Max Minghella (Nick), Warren Littlefield (Executive Producer) and Bruce Miller (Creator) discuss the flashbacks in episode 2 of The Handmaid's Tale that shed light on how America turned into Gilead, the role of a free press in a democracy and June's search for freedom.

episodes.name: From Script to Screen S02E03 "Baggage"
episodes.overview: Freedom to always leaves something behind. June (Elisabeth Moss) is caught between her future and her past. See how The Handmaid's Tale goes from script to your screen in this scene from Season 2, Episode 3 — "Baggage."

episodes.name: Inside the Episode S02E03 "Baggage"
episodes.overview: Samira Wiley (Moira), O-T Fagbenle (Luke), Bruce Miller (Creator) and Warren Littlefield (Executive Producer) delve into how survivors struggle to rebuild their lives and why the surprise ending of Episode 3 is rooted in reality.

episodes.name: From Script to Screen S02E04 "Other Women"
episodes.overview: Predator and prey. Serena Joy (Yvonne Strahovski) and Offred/June (Elisabeth Moss) play an intricate game of cat and mouse in this scene from The Handmaid's Tale -- "Other Women."

episodes.name: Inside the Episode S02E04 "Other Women"
episodes.overview: Is it still a party if half the guests don't want to celebrate? The cast and creators take you inside the latest episode of The Handmaids Tale — "Other Women."

episodes.name: From Script to Screen S02E05 "Seeds"
episodes.overview: Nobody escapes Aunt Lydia's watchful eye. Not even Serena Joy. In this scene from the episode "Seeds" featuring Serena Joy (Yvonne Strahovski) and Aunt Lydia (Ann Dowd) the most important things are those that are left unsaid.

episodes.name: Inside the Episode S02E05 "Seeds"
episodes.overview: Dive deeper into The Handmaid's Tale Season 2 Episode 5 "Seeds".

episodes.name: From Script to Screen S02E06 "First Blood"
episodes.overview: In the world of The Handmaid's Tale, there can be more meaning in what's left unsaid. In this script-to-screen, June and Serena play a delicate dance of vulnerability and harshness.

episodes.name: From Script to Screen S02E07 "After"
episodes.overview: After the return of Emily (Alexis Bledel) and Janine (Madeline Brewer) to Gilead, an idea is sparked in June (Elisabeth Moss) that spreads through the group of handmaids.

episodes.name: Inside the Episode S02E07 "After"
episodes.overview: There's a price to pay for any act of violence. Samira Wiley (Moira), Yvonne Strahovski (Serena Joy), O-T Fagbenle (Luke) and Warren Littlefield (Executive Producer) discuss the repercussions and reverberations of the attach in Gilead.

episodes.name: From Script to Screen S02E08 "Women's Work"
episodes.overview: Walls come down only to be built up again. Following a humiliating incident, June (Elisabeth Moss) and Serena Joy's (Yvonne Strahovski) detente comes to an abrupt end.

episodes.name: Inside the Episode S02E08 "Women's Work"
episodes.overview: Yvonne Strahovski (Serena Joy), Joseph Fiennes (Commander Waterford), Warren Littlefield (Executive Producer) and Bruce Miller (Creator) discusses the friction between the responsibilities of motherhood and the rules of Gilead.

episodes.name: From Script to Screen S02E09 "Smart Power"
episodes.overview: Worlds collide as Nick (Max Minghella) seeks out Luke (O-T Fagbenle) in a bar in Little America to relay news of June (Elisabeth Moss).

episodes.name: Inside the Episode S02E09 "Smart Power"
episodes.overview: The Waterfords' diplomatic trip to Canada is filled with confrontations and little diplomacy. Go inside the episode with Joseph Fiennes, Yvonne Strahovski, O-T Fagbenle, and Max Minghella.

episodes.name: Score Recording

episodes.name: From Script to Screen S02E10 "The Last Ceremony"
episodes.overview: June (Elisabeth Moss) and Nick (Max Minghella) prepare for the birth of their child, only to be faced with the reality of their situation when Serena Joy (Yvonne Strahovski) interrupts their secret reverie.

episodes.name: They Do Not Own You

episodes.name: Power Play - Gilead's Women Fight Back
Offred
episodes.overview: Offred, one the few fertile women known as Handmaids in the oppressive Republic of Gilead, struggles to survive as a reproductive surrogate for a powerful Commander and his resentful wife.

episodes.name: Birth Day
episodes.overview: Offred and her fellow Handmaids assist with the delivery of Janine’s baby, prompting Offred to recall her own daughter’s birth. Offred draws closer to Ofglen while dreading a secret meeting with the Commander.

episodes.name: Late
episodes.overview: Offred visits Janine’s baby with Serena Joy and remembers the early days of the revolution before Gilead. Ofglen faces a difficult challenge.

episodes.name: Nolite Te Bastardes Carborundorum
episodes.overview: Punished by Serena Joy, Offred begins to unravel and reflects on her time with Moira at the Red Center. A complication during the Ceremony threatens Offred’s survival with the Commander and Serena Joy.

episodes.name: Faithful
episodes.overview: Serena Joy makes Offred a surprising proposition. Offred remembers the unconventional beginnings of her relationship with her husband.

episodes.name: A Woman's Place
episodes.overview: A Mexican Ambassador visiting Gilead questions Offred about her life as a Handmaid. Serena Joy reflects on her marriage and the role she once played in Gilead’s inception.

episodes.name: The Other Side
episodes.overview: Remembering her family’s treacherous escape attempt, a shocking revelation from life before Gilead provides a new perspective on Offred’s life.

episodes.name: Jezebels
episodes.overview: The Commander surprises Offred with a secret adventure in Gilead. Nick’s troubled past leads to his recruitment by the Sons of Jacob.

episodes.name: The Bridge
episodes.overview: Offred embarks on a dangerous mission for the resistance. Janine moves to a new posting. Serena Joy suspects the Commander’s infidelity.

episodes.name: Night
episodes.overview: Serena Joy confronts Offred and the Commander. Offred struggles with a complicated, life-changing revelation. The Handmaids face a brutal decision.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Offred must navigate between Commanders, their cruel Wives, domestic Marthas, and her fellow Handmaids – where anyone could be a spy for Gilead – with one goal: to survive and find the daughter who was taken from her.

episodes.name: June
episodes.overview: Offred reckons with the consequences of a dangerous decision while haunted by memories from her past and the violent beginnings of Gilead.

episodes.name: Unwomen
episodes.overview: Offred adjusts to a new way of life. The arrival of an unexpected person disrupts the Colonies. A family is torn apart by the rise of Gilead.

episodes.name: Baggage
episodes.overview: Offred reflects on her relationship with her mother as she navigates her way through Gilead. In Little America, Moira tries to cope with the trauma she endured.

episodes.name: Other Women
episodes.overview: A baby shower provokes a troubling shift in Offred’s relationship with Serena Joy. Offred reckons with the choice she made that led her to become a Handmaid.

episodes.name: Seeds
episodes.overview: Offred spirals as a Gilead ceremony disrupts her relationship with Nick. Janine tries to adjust to life in the Colonies, jeopardizing her friendship with Emily.

episodes.name: First Blood
episodes.overview: Offred finds unexpected allies and obstacles in her search for a way to protect Hannah. The Commander prepares for the dedication of a new Red Center. Nick struggles with his new assignment.

episodes.name: After
episodes.overview: An attack sends shockwaves through both Gilead and Little America. Serena Joy makes a dangerous choice in order to protect her family. Moira searches for someone from her past.

episodes.name: Women's Work
episodes.overview: A sick baby tests Offred and Serena. Janine finally faces Naomi.

episodes.name: Smart Power
episodes.overview: The Waterfords embark on a diplomatic trip abroad. Serena faces the temptation of life outside Gilead. Luke and Moira grapple with survivor’s guilt. Offred seeks support from allies.

episodes.name: The Last Ceremony
episodes.overview: A frustrated Serena becomes desperate. The Commander tries to make amends with Offred. Nick pushes Eden farther away. Offred is faced with an unexpected reunion.

episodes.name: Holly
episodes.overview: Offred faces a grueling challenge alone as she recalls her life as a mother. Serena Joy and the Commander deal with the fallout of their actions towards Offred.

episodes.name: Postpartum
episodes.overview: Offred is sent to a familiar place. Nick is rocked by Gilead’s brutal response to a crime. Emily is assigned to a mysterious new house.

episodes.name: The Word
episodes.overview: Serena and the other Wives strive to make change. Emily learns more about her new Commander. Offred faces a difficult decision.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Season two is shaped by Offred’s pregnancy and her ongoing fight to free her future child from the dystopian horrors of Gilead. “Gilead is within you” is a favorite saying of Aunt Lydia and in this season, Offred and all our characters will fight against – or succumb to – this dark truth.

episodes.name: Night
episodes.overview: June embarks on a bold mission with unexpected consequences. Emily and Nichole make a harrowing journey. The Waterfords reckon with Serena Joy’s choice to send Nichole away.

episodes.name: Mary and Martha
episodes.overview: June helps Marthas with a dangerous task while navigating a relationship with her pious and untrustworthy new walking partner. Emily and Luke struggle with their altered circumstances.

episodes.name: Useful
episodes.overview: June navigates a meeting where she must face both Commander Waterford and Nick. Serena Joy attempts to recuperate at her mother’s home. Lawrence teaches June a hard lesson about the difficult decisions he makes as a Commander.

episodes.name: God Bless the Child
episodes.overview: June negotiates a truce in the Waterfords’ fractured relationship. Janine oversteps with the Putnam family, and a still-healing Aunt Lydia offers a brutal public punishment.

episodes.name: Unknown Caller
episodes.overview: June and Serena grapple with a new revelation about Nichole, leading to an incident that will have far-reaching ramifications.

episodes.name: Household
episodes.overview: June accompanies the Waterfords to Washington D.C., where a powerful family offers a glimpse of the future of Gilead. June makes an important connection as she attempts to protect Nichole.

episodes.name: Under His Eye
episodes.overview: June escalates her risky efforts to find Hannah. Emily must face her past crimes as the ongoing international diplomatic crisis becomes more complicated.

episodes.name: Unfit
episodes.overview: June and the rest of the Handmaids shun Ofmatthew, and both are pushed to their limit at the hands of Aunt Lydia. Aunt Lydia reflects on her life and relationships before the rise of Gilead.

episodes.name: Heroic
episodes.overview: Confined in a hospital, June’s sanity begins to fray. An encounter with Serena Joy forces June to reassess her recent actions.

episodes.name: Witness
episodes.overview: June must deal with a devious ploy on the part of Commander Waterford.

episodes.name: Liars
episodes.overview: A return to Jezebels puts everything in jeopardy; Serena Joy and Commander Waterford take a clandestine trip.

episodes.name: Sacrifice
episodes.overview: Gilead leadership is rocked by losses among their own. Luke and Moira adjust to new arrivals in Canada. June worries about disruptions to her plan, only to have tragedy strike the entire household.

episodes.name: Mayday
episodes.overview: With her plan in place, June reaches the point of no return on her bold strike against Gilead and must decide how far she’s willing to go. Serena Joy and Commander Waterford attempt to find their way forward in their new lives.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Season three is driven by June's resistance to the dystopian regime of Gilead and her struggle to strike back against overwhelming odds. Startling reunions, betrayals, and a journey to the terrifying heart of Gilead force all characters to take a stand, guided by one defiant prayer: "Blessed be the fight."

episodes.name: Pigs
episodes.overview: On the run, June and the fugitive Handmaids seek refuge. In Gilead, Aunt Lydia reels from the loss of 86 children on Angels’ Flight. The combative Waterfords, in custody in Toronto, learn of June’s feat.

episodes.name: Nightshade
episodes.overview: June plots revenge at the local Jezebels, before she and the Handmaids plan to leave the farm for the next safe house. In Toronto, Moira deals with the fallout of June’s choices, and Serena and Fred are bound together by a miracle.

episodes.name: The Crossing
episodes.overview: Captured by Gilead, June faces a vengeful Aunt Lydia and endures a torturous interrogation. Nick and Lawrence collaborate to protect June. In Toronto, Luke struggles with how to help June and Hannah.

episodes.name: Milk
episodes.overview: June takes a harrowing journey with Janine, trying to escape Gilead, as Janine remembers a stressful experience in her past. In Toronto, Serena tries to manipulate Rita, who seeks advice from Moira.

episodes.name: Chicago
episodes.overview: June seeks out more active rebels in the Chicago war zone, while Janine tries to help her fit in with their new group of survivors. Moira goes on her first field aid mission.

episodes.name: Vows
episodes.overview: After a shocking reunion with a dear friend, June contemplates the possibility of freedom, and confronts the unfulfilled promises she’s made to herself and to Luke.

episodes.name: Home
episodes.overview: June contends with joy, pain and rage as she acclimates herself to vastly changed circumstances.

episodes.name: Testimony
episodes.overview: June confronts Fred and Serena in court and challenges Emily to face a painful reminder of her Gilead past. Lawrence presents Aunt Lydia with a newly captured, familiar handmaid.

episodes.name: Progress
episodes.overview: June and Luke work together to save Hannah, reaching out to Lawrence and Nick for help. Serena and Fred greet unexpected visitors from Gilead. Janine tries to assist Aunt Lydia when a Handmaid-in-training goes on a hunger strike at the Red Center.

episodes.name: The Wilderness
episodes.overview: June draws on all her resources and relationships, risking everything to ensure her own kind of justice.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: June strikes back against Gilead as a fierce rebel leader, but the risks she takes bring unexpected and dangerous new challenges. Her quest for justice and revenge threatens to consume her and destroy her most cherished relationships.

episodes.name: Morning
episodes.overview: June confronts the consequences of killing Fred. A scared Serena makes an unexpected decision.

episodes.name: Ballet
episodes.overview: June struggles to move on with her life in Toronto. Serena plans an elaborate memorial. Aunt Lydia and Janine prepare Esther for her first posting as a Handmaid.

episodes.name: Border
episodes.overview: June and Moira join a rebel outpost. As a pregnant widow, Serena tries to restore her status. Aunt Lydia questions her strict methods of dealing with Handmaids.

episodes.name: Dear Offred
episodes.overview: June fights her need for violent revenge as Serena settles into her new role in Toronto. Rattled by Janine, Aunt Lydia makes a surprising suggestion to Lawrence.

episodes.name: Fairytale
episodes.overview: June and Luke embark on a dangerous quest. Serena gets to know her new hosts.

episodes.name: Together
episodes.overview: June and Luke’s mission puts them in serious jeopardy. Serena senses a threat from her benefactors. Lawrence and Nick make a shocking power move.

episodes.name: No Man's Land
episodes.overview: June and Serena find themselves in a desperate situation.

episodes.name: Motherland
episodes.overview: June considers a tempting but risky offer from a surprise visitor. Serena hits rock bottom and searches for allies.

episodes.name: Allegiance
episodes.overview: June and Luke prepare for a rescue mission. Serena tries new tactics with her oppressive hosts. Lawrence makes a surprising proposal to elevate his status.

episodes.name: Safe
episodes.overview: Under threat, June must find a way to keep herself and her family safe from Gilead and its violent supporters in Toronto.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: June faces consequences for killing Commander Waterford while struggling to redefine her identity and purpose. The widowed Serena attempts to raise her profile in Toronto as Gilead’s influence creeps into Canada. Commander Lawrence works with Nick and Aunt Lydia as he tries to reform Gilead and rise in power. June, Luke and Moira fight Gilead from a distance as they continue their mission to save and reunite with Hannah.

episodes.name: Train
episodes.overview: June and Serena's journey takes an unexpected turn. Moira makes a bold decision. Nick deals with a powerful visitor.

episodes.name: Exile
episodes.overview: June tries to settle in a new community. Serena seeks sanctuary. Luke and Moira take a big risk.

episodes.name: Devotion
episodes.overview: June struggles to save her loved ones. Commander Lawrence welcomes diplomats to New Bethlehem. Aunt Lydia searches for Janine.

episodes.name: Promotion
episodes.overview: June disrupts the rebel's plans. Commander Lawrence gains power and influence

episodes.name: Janine
episodes.overview: June and Moira go undercover. Serena and Nick make consequential choices.

episodes.name: Surprise
episodes.overview: June hides in an unexpected place.

episodes.name: Shattered
episodes.overview: After a shocking revelation, June spirals. Serena plans for a prestigious future.

episodes.name: Exodus
episodes.overview: June and Moira execute their dangerous plan. Serena makes a big commitment.

episodes.name: Execution
episodes.overview: June faces her biggest challenge as Gilead cracks down on the rebels.

episodes.name: The Handmaid's Tale
episodes.overview: June reflects on her experiences in Gilead and decides what to do next.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: June's unyielding spirit and determination pull her back into the fight to take down Gilead. Luke and Moira join the resistance. Serena tries to reform Gilead while Commander Lawrence and Aunt Lydia reckon with what they have wrought, and Nick faces challenging tests of character. This final chapter of June's journey highlights the importance of hope, courage, solidarity, and resilience in the pursuit of justice and freedom.

reviews.author: Reno
reviews.content:
****From June to Offred: A 21st century slave tale!**

**SEASON 01:****

I was not sure to give it a try, in the end I just went on. The reason was, another dystopian theme. It was a short season with the 10 episodes, and I've got a mixed feeling. It was based on the 30 year old novel of the same name. I mean 3 decades old source is very old in the present trend. Since that book there were plenty of films, series were made similar to that theme, including one feature film adaptation. I don't know the screenplay was highly borrowed from its original source, but all I expected was alterable.

Even though I felt familiarity, I enjoyed watching it. My issue was the drag. The whole season was a drag. Dragged to have one more season, or maybe more in the future. Especially I was very disappointed with the season finale. It only felt like a mid-season finale and yet a lot more to come in the same season. But that was only my assumption, this season ended at the halfway. They had held back too much to have some of it in the upcoming seasons. That's very intense move from the production perspective, but for the viewers, it left with unsatisfying.

The plus points were the casting and production. Elisabeth Moss was very good. Her expressions saved in parts of the earlier episodes. Particularly, her smile during those circus were going on, instead of being tensed and confused. That reveals the character, who wants to stay alive for a reason. As the story progresses in the next episodes, you would know more reasons why. Alexis' part was short, as well as many others. The overall the characters design was good. But I anticipated more from the story side to reveal.

In the near future, the humans had lost fertility capacity, excluding a very few men and women. Those who are capable of having babies are taken as slave surrogate mothers, after separating from their husbands and kids, to assign them those who desire to have children. This tale follows Offred, who is one of the maids. Her struggle against the couple who took her in, and overall society, how it treated her and others like her. The American dreams are gone. Many fled to Canada and yet some are trying to make it there. But Offred is not concerned about that. She now has to find her daughter before planning anything.

Each epidoe was decent, but only a couple of them were top class. At least now we know what to expect from the follow-up season. Also the perspective of the story was very restricted like everything was from Offred. The episode like 'The Other Side' really made it interesting. We need more those kind of explanation of what's going on on the other side. Especially for a television series, they have all the time to detail out from all the angle. That's what I like in the series, otherwise I'm always a film fanatic, love to watch short and sweet tales. So I'm waiting for the season 2.

_7/10_

reviews.author: MovieGuys
reviews.content:
Every now and then a production comes along that such an absolute gem, it has you lost for words.

A Handmaids Tale, is based on the novel by Canadian author Margaret Atwood . I have not yet read the book but if this series is anything to go by, it will, I'm sure, make its way into my collection very soon.

On the surface the premise behind the series seems novel. Yet when you consider the fate of women in contemporary and historic theocratic societies, its not so far fetched. Indeed, what Atwood has rather cleverly done, is transplant aspects of life in theocratic societies, most notably Medieval Europe and Puritan colonial America, into a futuristic setting using civil war as a vehicle. A biological imperative is introduced too, in the form of pollution induced human sterility. Fertile women in Gilead (formerly the USA) are reduced to human incubators, their only imperative to produce children.

On face value, this might seem to be a story about the subjugation and commoditization of women. Indeed, it is that. Yet, what this series is ultimately about is the hypocrisy of intolerance. Not just women but any individual or group, who diverge from the rigid religious script, meet a grim fate. Meanwhile, those controlling the dialogue, are more or less free to make and break their own rules, as they see fit. Even those who do follow the societal script, often do so for reasons that are in opposition to those they claim to uphold.

For my money everything about this series is superb. Elizabeth Moss is a wonderful, off beat choice, for Offred the handmaid to a powerful commander, who is directly responsible for hers and others suffering. Joseph Fiennes, is capable in the role of the superficially charming but emotionally empty commander.

Update: Yes a decent series but, for my money, its run on too long and now simply appears to be recycling the original script with a few twists and turns. At times, in my opinion, perilously close to looking like misandry, too. 

In short, an engrossing, thoughtful and engaging series but it needs to come to a close, as it no longer has much more to say, that has not already been said.

reviews.author: GenerationofSwine
reviews.content:
People are going to look back at the Censorship decade and think that this and Harry Potter are the only two books the cancel culture freaks read...

... and then realize that they were both adapted for the screen.

This was good when they made it for HBO in the 1990s when it had an actual plot and was actually pro-Atwood.

Only the people that made this turned on Atwood during #MeToo when she spoke out in favor of Due Process and then it slowly started to distance itself from her IP... as it became more and more in your face political.

And that is when things like this lose me.

reviews.author: skyxdeziix0v
reviews.content:
The Handmaid's Tale was an extraordinary series from start to finish; one of those productions that leaves a mark due to its rawness, its impeccable visual style, and its dystopian atmosphere, which is both captivating and terrifying. Its portrayal of the regime of Gilead and women's resistance keeps you on edge season after season.

Janine is the heart of the story:

Janine was what captivated me most about the series. She is my favorite character because she embodies extreme vulnerability and a touching, unexpected resilience. While other main characters carry the more obvious burden of political struggle or revenge, Janine experiences pain, loss, and trauma in a remarkably human and moving way. Her wounded innocence and her bravery, almost like a game of tic-tac-toe, give the story an astonishing authenticity that transcends the cruelty of Gilead.

Ultimately, this is an unmissable series that, while sometimes hard to digest due to its explicit psychological violence, rewards viewers with unforgettable character arcs like Janine's.
